{{Otheruses|Jedi starfighter}}
The '''Redshift''' was a class of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] that was used by the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Following the end of the conflict, the Redshift was considered to be outdated, so the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] replaced them with the [[Savage Star fighter]].<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)]]</ref>
